guidance: I think earlier guidance is around 60 to 80 stores.

capex: And that's the reason we continue with our expansion plan of 60 to 80 stores.
And until the expansion happens, it will be difficult to drive double -digit growth or 15% growth.
risks: And this is despite the challenges in terms of the pricing pressures which we faced on the energy cost, especially in the terms of gas cost.
However, profitability remained an issue because of inflationary pressures.
focus: We launched new products, the new Crafted Flatzz product, baked chicken wings, a new line of masala beverages.
W e'll keep our focus on the next five years where, we plan to double the store count.
Until then, we continue to focus on the brand in Tamil Nadu in particular, and on the dine-in and takeaway channel.
